scope: B system repair plus model-assisted diagnosis, not autonomous code repair
primary_failure: R01 then R02 returns v1 evidence for v2 request

hypotheses.cache: Query-only cache causes cross-version reuse; resetting removes stale answer for original k=2
hypotheses.retrieval: Global top-k before scope independently drops evidence; cold v2 k=1 still misses b02

model_experiment.prediction: Specific trace evidence may improve grounded diagnosis; category labels alone may only cause repetition. No guaranteed gain.
model_experiment.limits: Three hand-selected known defects; human/AI-authored labels. Same output cap, unequal input lengths. No claim of generic repair success.
model_experiment.stop: API/JSON/truncation/usage/cost anomaly stops batch without retry. Wrong substantive diagnoses are retained as outcomes.
